skins.name: Constellation
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: Your apps as a night-sky map. Favourites form a bright constellation, other apps are fainter stars, and a three.js sky that can move in depth as you fly from star to star.

skins.name: Tidepool
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A calm deep-sea pool: glass pebbles for your apps, and caustic light (three.js) that takes the colour of the app you pick.

skins.name: Paper Cut
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A hand-made paper diorama: layered paper hills (three.js) that follow the time of day, pinned paper cards for your apps, and optional depth motion.

skins.name: Live Aquarium
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A planted reef tank fills the screen; fish swim for a while after each key press, then rest. Your apps sit in one quiet row, and the row steps aside when you only watch.

skins.name: Holiday
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A cosy living room on a winter evening: the fire flickers, the tree lights twinkle and snow falls outside for a while after each key press. Your apps sit in one quiet row.

skins.name: Code Rain
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: Streams of glowing code fall in depth over a dark floor. Each app is a stream that ends in its picture and name; the rain falls for a while after each key press, then holds still.

skins.name: Phosphor
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A 1980s green-screen terminal as your home screen. Level 1: only CSS on the launcher's own layout, no scripts.

skins.name: Bauhaus
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A 1920s poster as your home screen: a giant clock over a red circle, primary-colour blocks with one shape each, and the focused app set vertically. Level 2: a layout file and CSS.

skins.name: Playroom
skins.author: Web TV Launcher
skins.description: A toy box for children: chunky building blocks, a clock made of toy blocks and a friendly mascot that looks at what you pick. Other apps stay behind a grown-up switch.
